### The True Family of Jesus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/true-family-jesus
Passage: Mark 3:31-35
Points:
- Natural family ties are usually the deepest bonds people experience in this life.
- Jesus revealed that His earthly relatives held no exclusive claim or privileged access to Him.
- True family in the kingdom of God is defined by faith and obedience to God's will.
- This spiritual relationship is equally open to believing men and women as His brothers and sisters.
- Believers are welcomed into intimate union with Christ and guarded as His family members.

### Bible Pathway - Oct. 5, 2011
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-oct-5-2011.html
Passage: Matthew 12:46-50
Points:
- Jesus did not let family demands disrupt His primary commitment to God's work.
- He used an unexpected interruption to reveal a new view of spiritual family.
- Anyone who receives Christ and does the Father's will is welcomed into this relationship.
- Natural human relationships must be subordinated to allegiance to the kingdom of God.
- Believers are privileged to share an eternal bond as brothers and sisters in Christ.
